title: Extending finite-test isomorphisms between profinite functors
statement: Let G,H : Profinite_u → C be functors to any category. Suppose that for each profinite S both functors send its canonical finite-quotient limit cone to a limit cone. Every natural isomorphism between their restrictions to finite sets extends to a natural isomorphism G ≅ H.

source.place: Proof of Lemma 2.2.8, comparison through canonical finite-quotient limits.

proof.text: The canonical quotient projections are surjective. Mathlib Profinite.Extend.isLimitCone therefore identifies each image G(S), and similarly H(S), as a limit over all maps from S to finite sets.

source.place: Proof of Lemma 2.2.8, comparison through canonical finite-quotient limits.

proof.text: Whisker the finite natural isomorphism with the category of finite tests of S, and transport the cone of G along it. This preserves its limiting property. The transported cone and the cone of H are limits of the same diagram, so uniqueness of limits gives G(S) ≅ H(S), compatibly with every finite projection.

proof.text: For a map S → T, test the naturality square at every finite map T → A. Both composites equal the finite comparison after the image of S → T → A, so they agree by the limiting property.
